messages:
Marissa Cole: GA decision meeting thread. can folks drop final status for Usage Insights (cost drivers by route) here today?

Decision needed by EOD:
1) GA date (proposed: Tue/Thu next week)
2) any remaining GA blockers
3) rollout plan (ff stages)

If you own a gate, please respond with ✅ / ⚠️ / ❌ and the latest metric/issue link.

Paula Mendes: PM view: ✅ for GA next week if we agree to GA-with-limits as documented.
Top open items from my list:
- clarify invoice reconciliation disclaimer in-product (copy + link to FAQ)
- export max time range + row limit language consistent across UI + docs
- confirm “Unknown route” handling + best-practices callout is shipped

Proposed GA date from release coord: Thu (gives us 48h after final beta push).

Talia Benson: Program status: overall ✅ if SRE + Sec are green.
Checklist doc is here (internal): https://docs.redwoodinference.com/internal/usage-insights/ga-checklist
Remaining “needs owner signoff” items:
- SLOs in Confluence published
- release notes draft final review
- support macros ready

Logan Wright: Telemetry/analytics: ✅
Latest metrics (last 24h on staging + dogfood orgs):
- pipeline lag p95: 11.8m (target <30m customer-facing)
- aggregates job duration p95: 4m (hourly), 2m (daily)
- top routes API p95: 410ms @ 50rps load test (budget 800ms)
- route cardinality: 18.2k unique/day across dogfood (budget 50k/day global), “unknown_route” at 6.4% of reqs (down from 19% after SDK updates)

Open issues:
- one remaining edge case: fallback mid-request can show “Model used” but export JSON can be missing `requested_model` field when gateway-derived route present (ENG-8435 follow-up). Not a blocker IMO; affects a small slice; UI unaffected.

Thomas Baird: Cardinality controls: ⚠️ (but OK to GA)
We’re seeing periodic spikes when customers include query params in route tag (e.g., `/search?q=…`). Our normalizer strips querystring when gateway-derived, but SDK-provided route can still include it.
Mitigation shipping:
- server-side normalization: strip `?` and everything after for SDK-provided route (already merged behind ff)
- hard cap: if per-org unique routes/hour > threshold, roll up to `route_overflow` and emit audit metric

Ask: GA copy should explicitly say “Do not include IDs or query params in route”.

Allison Grant: SRE signoff: ✅ (with staged rollout)
Current on-call concerns were export timeouts under long ranges; latest fixes look good.
Metrics from last dogfood push:
- insights API availability: 99.96% (7d)
- 5xx rate: 0.12% (24h)
- export job success rate: 98.9% (24h), p95 duration 38s (CSV), 22s (JSON) for “7d / top 500 routes”
Alerts created + routed:
- pipeline lag >30m for 15m (page)
- export failure rate >5% over 1h (page)
- API 5xx >1% over 10m (page)
- cardinality overflow events >0.5% of requests (ticket)
Runbook link is in #eng-sre bookmarks, also: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/x/usage-insights-sre

Rollout requirement: 0%->internal->beta->10%->50%->100% with 2h bake each step. If anything regresses, we pause at 10%.

Kevin Osei: Security/audit logging: ✅
Audit events are emitted for:
- `usage_report.export_requested`
- `usage_report.export_ready`
- `usage_report.downloaded`
We include actor, org/project, filters (time range, env, region, deployment mode), format, row count, and export_id.
Retention: matches standard audit log retention policy.
RBAC checks verified in PR-15492; export respects project scoping.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: RBAC/tenant isolation: ✅
We added regression tests for cross-project leakage on:
- route list
- route detail
- export job creation + download
One flaky test in CI was fixed (race on fixture org creation). No known gaps.

Dylan Brooks: Console: ✅
UI readiness:
- route list table + filters + sparkline shipped behind ff `usage_insights`
- route detail with model breakdown + prior period deltas shipped
- empty states: missing route tag -> shows “Unknown route” callout + link to docs
- export flow: “Export report” CTA, bounded to max 7d in UI right now

Known UX limitations (documented):
- for 24h range, hourly data can still shift for ~1–2h due to late metering (we show “Data may be delayed” banner)
- if route rolled up to `route_overflow`, we show a warning pill

Chloe Martin: Backend API: ✅
Perf/load testing summary:
- route list endpoint p95 430ms @ 200 concurrent, cache hit ~72%
- route detail endpoint p95 510ms
- export create endpoint p95 180ms
Rate limits: export create is capped per user/org to prevent spam.

Only thing I’d like to sneak in before GA: better error code on export when time range too large (`EXPORT_RANGE_TOO_LARGE`), currently generic 400. Not a blocker.

Monica Patel: SDKs: ✅
TS + Python both support `route` tagging; docsstrings updated.
We’ve defaulted to NOT auto-deriving route client-side (to avoid surprises). Guidance is explicit.
Open item: Go SDK route helper is in progress; not required for GA (we’ll document header-based tagging as workaround).

Elliot Price: Docs: ⚠️
Content is ready, screenshots are the hold.
- “Usage insights overview” page drafted
- “Tagging routes” page includes naming conventions + pitfalls
- “Export reports” page includes CSV/JSON schemas + limits + audit logging behavior

Need by tomorrow noon:
- 2 screenshots from console staging (route list + route detail)
- 1 screenshot of export modal
If we get those, I can publish same day.

Tessa Morgan: Design: ✅
Reviewed final IA + copy. Biggest risk is confusion around “Model used” vs “Model requested” when fallback happens.
We added tooltips:
- “Model used: may differ from requested due to capacity fallback”
- delta chip: “Compared to prior period”

Also reviewed overflow/unknown banners; they’re fine.

Dev Patel: Support readiness: ✅
- macros drafted for:
  1) invoice vs console mismatch (freshness + cached token accounting)
  2) “Unknown route” dominating (SDK tagging/gateway config)
  3) export timeout / too-large range (reduce range, use pagination)
- known issues page ready to publish once docs URLs are final

Ask: please confirm final GA date so we can schedule internal enablement + tag CSMs.

Connor O'Brien: Release coord: ✅
Proposed timeline:
- Tue: enable for internal + beta orgs (existing ff)
- Thu: GA announcement + start staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100% same day if metrics green)
Need final go/no-go by tomorrow 10am PT for release notes + announcements.

Marissa Cole: thx all. summarizing:
- SRE ✅ (requires staged rollout)
- Sec ✅
- Telemetry ✅ (minor export field edge case)
- Console ✅
- Docs ⚠️ (screenshots)

Decision:
✅ We will GA on Thu pending docs publish + screenshot delivery by tomorrow noon.

Action items:
- Dylan + Felix: deliver 3 screenshots to Elliot by tomorrow 11am PT
- Paula: final GA-with-limits copy (export 7d cap, data freshness, invoice mismatch disclaimer) into release notes by tomorrow
- Connor: lock rollout plan + ff steps with Allison
- Logan/Thomas: ensure server-side normalization for SDK route query params is ON by default at GA

If docs slip, we still ship code but we do NOT flip beyond beta. agreed?

Allison Grant: +1. if docs aren’t live, keep it beta. :thumbsup:

Elliot Price: works. I’ll block my afternoon for publish once I have the images.

Paula Mendes: agreed. I’ll update the release notes draft + GA checklist w/ this decision.

Dylan Brooks: ok I’ll grab screenshots from staging after today’s deploy. will DM Elliot.

Marissa Cole: cool. closing thread unless new blockers show up. pls reply here if anything turns red.
